name: OPEM Psychology Honours Scholarship (SCU)
summary: $1,000 for a full-time on-campus SCU psychology honours student, with preference for sustainability research.
who: Australian citizen, permanent resident or permanent humanitarian visa holder.
Enrolled full-time on campus in the honours year of the Bachelor of Psychological Science with Honours.
how: Apply through SCU's applying for a scholarship page with a research proposal of up to two pages and a CV.

source.label: Southern Cross University: OPEM Psychology Honours Scholarship
